ns2:course.label: Introduction to Old Norse I
ns2:course.description: Provides a solid proficiency in reading texts in Old Norse, the language of the Viking sagas and mythology. Meets concurrently with SCAN 505. Prerequisite: Any SCAN course or knowledge or one other foreign language.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Any SCAN course or knowledge or one other foreign language.
